# kcore_object_store (Resource)

RGW object store (`kctl create object-store`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kcore_object_store" "s3" {
  name         = "s3"
  ceph_cluster = kcore_ceph_cluster.lab.name
  port         = 7480
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ceph_cluster` (String)
- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `members` (List of String)
- `port` (Number)
- `rgw_id` (String)
- `tls` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `health_message` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `phase` (String)
